title: E2E: POST article -> GROUP -> OVER -> ARTICLE returns real data
description:
What: End-to-end integration test proving the full data flow: POST an article, then GROUP shows it, OVER lists it, ARTICLE fetches it.
Algorithm:
1. In crates/reader/tests/, create integration test e2e_data_flow.rs:
   a. Create ServerStores::new_mem() (no real IPFS)
   b. Start a listener on 127.0.0.1:0 (random port)
   c. Post a test article: telnet-style write RFC 5536 headers + body
   d. Send GROUP comp.test -> verify 211 response with count=1
   e. Send OVER -> verify 224 response with the article subject
   f. Send ARTICLE <message-id> -> verify 220 response with article body
2. Use tokio::test with a timeout to prevent hangs
3. Article: From: test@example.com, Subject: Test Article, Newsgroups: comp.test, Message-ID: <test-e2e@example.com>
Defensive: test should use MemIpfsStore (no real IPFS node needed); test should clean up the port listener on completion.
Acceptance: cargo test e2e_data_flow passes; no panics; no test-only code in production paths.
